rows.grounds: compound of putra (son) and arthin (desiring); nominative subject
verb expressing attainment by the desiring person
object of attainment for one desiring offspring
compound of dhana (wealth) and arthin (desiring); nominative subject
verb expressing attainment by the desiring person
object of attainment for one desiring riches

items.question: Which specific worldly desires are fulfilled for practitioners seeking offspring or wealth?
premises: A person desiring a son performs or benefits from the practice.
Such a person obtains a son.
A person desiring wealth obtains wealth.
items.inference: The practice grants fulfillment of specific desires for offspring and wealth.
items.plain_english: One who desires a son obtains a son, and one who desires wealth obtains wealth.
